title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Humphreys Concerts By The Bay, San Diego | 2000
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Humphreys Concerts By The Bay in San Diego, California, USA, on 25 June 2000.

It was the 28th show by the sixth All-Starr Band, and the first of two consecutive nights in San Diego. Their North American tour lasted for 32 dates between May and July 2000.

Starr had previously performed at Humphreys Concerts By The Bay on 16 August 1995 and 4 May 1997. He returned there on 7 September 2003, 29 June 2006, 27 July 2008, 6 August 2010, 19 July 2012, 11 July 2014, 1 July 2016, 27 September 2018, 28 and 31 May 2023, 7 September 2024, and 29 May 2026.

The sixth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Dave Edmunds: vocals, guitar
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Eric Carmen: vocals, keyboards, guitar, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, guitar, organ, keyboards, percussion, harmonica
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums
